# Last Actor run's default dataset

The API endpoints described in this section are convenience endpoints that provide access to Actor's last run's default dataset without the need to resolve the dataset ID first.

Subset of functionality described in: [Datasets](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/storage-datasets.md)

<!-- -->

## [Get last run's default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-get.md)

## [Update last run's default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-put.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-put.md)

## [Delete last run's default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-delete.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-delete.md)

## [Get last run's dataset items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-items-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/dataset/items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-items-get.md)

## [Store items in last run's dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-items-post.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/dataset/items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-items-post.md)

## [Get last run's dataset statistics](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-statistics-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/dataset/statistics](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-dataset-statistics-get.md)
